name: Forest Trapper
description: A woodlander with a simple hunting bow capable of tracking game and foes alike.

name: Elven Fletcher
description: A skilled archer who crafts precise arrows that pierce enemy armor.

name: Hawkeye Marksman
description: A sharp-eyed sniper who can spot and shoot down targets from hundreds of paces.

name: Stormbow Hunter
description: An agile tracker who imbues piercing volleys with crackling gale force.

name: Celestial Deadeye
description: A legendary marksman whose glowing energy arrows never deviate from their mark.

name: Goddess of the Hunt
description: A divine huntress capable of raining celestial arrows across the entire battlefield.
